verdict.rationale: Alloy's docs show event types can be mapped to Source Workflows that automatically route and evaluate submitted events. Those workflows apply policy logic and generate alerts or investigations when thresholds are met, supporting actions like interdicting transactions, step-up after PII changes, or rejecting logins. Missing for 10: documentation of how rules and conditions are authored or configured, detail on the range of triggerable actions beyond decisions and alerts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: any event can be submitted for additional monitoring by mapping the event type to a Source Workflow. When enabled, Alloy stores the data submitted on events and automatically routes all requests
Monitors transaction events in real time or at scheduled times to detect suspicious activity, apply policy logic, and generate alerts or investigations when thresholds are met.
interdicting on transactions, performing step-up after suspicious PII changes, or rejecting unusual login activity
